title: Personal Network Scanner
tech_stack: Python standard library, CLI, ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON, CSV
summary: Cautious CLI and local web UI for inventorying devices and open services on owned personal networks.
highlights: Private-network safety checks are enabled by default.
Supports CIDR, single-IP, comma-separated, and local-network target selection.
The web UI provides scan setup, live progress, device hints, service charts, filtering, and JSON export.

services.label: Scanner web UI
services.description: Runs the local authorized-network scanner UI.
